questions.q: What did Jeremiah hide in a chamber in the rock, 2 Maccabees says?
questions.evidence: And Jeremiah came and found a chamber in the rock, and there he brought in the tabernacle, and the ark, and the altar of incense

questions.q: What struck down the man who came to seize the temple treasury?
options: A horse with a terrible rider
questions.evidence: For there was seen by them a horse with a terrible rider upon him

questions.q: What did the old scribe Eleazar refuse to do, even to save his life?
questions.evidence: Eleazar, one of the principal scribes, a man already well stricken in years, and of a noble countenance, was compelled to open his mouth to eat swine’s flesh

questions.q: How many brothers were arrested with their mother?
questions.evidence: And it came to pass that seven brethren also with their mother were at the king’s command taken and shamefully handled with scourges and cords, to compel them to taste of the abominable swine’s flesh

questions.q: How could the mother bear seeing her seven sons die in one day?
questions.evidence: for when she looked on seven sons perishing within the space of one day, she bare the sight with a good courage for the hopes that she had set on the Lord
answerTerms: hopes that she had set on the lord

questions.q: What swarmed out of the body of Antiochus as he died?
questions.evidence: so that out of the body of the impious man worms swarmed, and while he was still living in anguish and pains, his flesh fell off, and by reason of the stench all the army turned with loathing from his corruption

questions.q: How did the last battle against Nicanor end?
options: Nicanor lay dead in his armor
questions.evidence: And when the engagement was over, and they were returning again with joy, they recognized Nicanor lying dead in full armor

questions.q: For whom did Judas make propitiation, that they might be released from sin?
questions.evidence: Wherefore he made the propitiation for them that had died, that they might be released from their sin
